title: Twisted star tower (loft massing)
summary: A star-shaped floor outline is made from a circle, filleted, copied up in floors and rotated a little more at each level; lofting the floors gives a twisting tower mass.
how_to_use: 'Star points' sets the number of star points; 'Star depth' how deep the star is cut in; 'Corner fillet' rounds the corners.
'Floor height' and 'Floors' set the stacking; 'Twist per floor' is the extra rotation (degrees) of each level.
Loft options: the Value List picks the loft type; the toggle and 'Refit' adjust it.
Bake 'Loft' for the tower envelope, or the Rot3D output for the floor-plate outlines.
concepts: Alternating lists: Longest List repeats a short pattern (1, 0) over all points
Amplitude: moving points along their own direction to make a star
Series as floor heights and as rotation angles

steps.title: 1  INPUTS - change these
steps.explain: Star shape, number and height of floors, twist per floor, and the loft options.

steps.title: 2  Star floor outline
steps.explain: A Circle is divided into points. Longest List repeats the pattern 1,0,1,0 over the points, so every second point is pushed outward along its own direction (Vector + Amplitude) by Star depth. A closed PolyLine joins them into a star and Fillet rounds the corners.

steps.title: 3  Stack and twist the floors
steps.explain: One Series gives each floor its height (Unit Z) and another gives each floor its rotation angle. Move copies the outline up; Rotate 3D twists each copy around the vertical axis.

steps.title: 4  RESULT - loft the tower
steps.explain: Loft skins all floor outlines into one twisting envelope, using the Loft Options from step 1.
